A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Spectral Sphere Optimizer research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A.1–A.5 are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original pretraining experiments, downstream evaluations, optimizer timing measurements, ablations and simulations, including Tables 1–3 and appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental and simulation results, including the dense, MoE and 200-layer model experiments and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same spectral constraints, momentum, Lagrange-multiplier search, matrix-sign update and retraction. The revised preliminary formulation in Section 2.2 does not change the stated SSO procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same OLMo training data, downstream benchmarks and dense, MoE, depth-stability and width-scaling scenarios. Appendix A.5 corrects 'Olmo2-mix124' to 'Olmo2-mix-1124'; the surrounding description and citation indicate a naming correction.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged in the corresponding experiments, including AdamW, Muon and MuonSphere where previously evaluated. Prodigy's removal from the preliminary discussion does not remove an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 6 retains the same 100B training tokens, 1B validation tokens, batch size, schedule, architectures, metrics and solver settings. Appendix A.5 retains its 30B-token budget and learning-rate and width sweeps. The weight-decay wording correction does not establish a changed experimental configuration.

E4.justification: The radius, learning-rate-scaler, module-granularity, weight-decay, width-transfer and depth-stability analyses are retained. Figures 2, 5–7 and 10–12 provide the same evidence; no ablation or robustness analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 3 still reports averaging over five repeats, and Appendix A.4's simulation listing retains 10,000 iterations. Neither version introduces different seed reporting, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the empirical plots retain their values and findings. For example, Table 3's average accuracies remain 54.75, 55.26, 56.19 and 56.35 for AdamW, Muon, MuonSphere and Spectral Sphere, respectively. Appendix results also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 2.2, Equations (3)–(4), replaces quadratic-penalized minimization with linearized-loss minimization subject to a norm bound of eta. It removes the requirement eta = ||G||†/lambda and instead treats eta as prescribed. This locally revises the mathematical definition; the SSO derivation and appendix proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions and claims about constrained steepest descent, alignment with spectral µP, convergence, activation control, router balance and learning-rate transfer.

C2.justification: The explanations of activation stability, routing balance, spectral freedom and optimization behavior are retained. Sections 5.3 and 7 preserve the same solver-overhead limitations, precision concerns, future improvements and recommendation of MuonSphere when infrastructure cost matters.

D1.justification: Footnote 3 replaces the misleading category '1D params (e.g. Embedding, RMSNorm)' with 'params like Embedding' and changes 'disabling 1D params' to 'disabling weight decay.' Appendix A.5 also corrects the corpus identifier. These are limited technical-documentation corrections; implementation settings, code listing and project link otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 adds the reference 'Critical batch size for steepest descent under arbitrary norms' and removes the Prodigy citation. Other reference changes largely update bibliographic metadata, including the same Yang spectral-condition work and NVIDIA resource. The main novelty positioning is retained.

P1.justification: Section 2.2 receives a localized rewrite. Elsewhere, v3 makes small terminology and grammar corrections, updates affiliations and acknowledgements, and revises reference metadata without reorganizing sections. Equation (10) acquires a stray 'eq' text artifact.

P2.justification: Figure 4 receives small label-styling and legend-position changes, while Figures 2 and 9 have minor caption edits. The revised preliminary equations and bibliography cause local layout reflow. No figure or table is added or removed, and empirical display structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The prescribed-step formulation in Section 2.2 connects the preliminary mathematics more directly to Algorithm 1's learning-rate-controlled update. Corrected dimension notation and weight-decay wording also improve clarity. These limited gains outweigh the new stray 'eq' artifact in Equation (10), while the algorithm, empirical evidence and appendix proofs remain unchanged.
